specific_explanation: The payload contains a <script> tag, which is a direct client-side script injection pattern.
If rendered unsafely, the browser may execute attacker-controlled JavaScript.

meta.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT; Windows NT 10.0; en-US) WindowsPowerShell/5.1.26100.8894

summary.message: A high-severity Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payload classified as Script-tag XSS was detected in a POST request to /api/xai/report originating from IP address 127.0.0.1 using a WindowsPowerShell user agent. The payload <script>alert(1)</script> was identified with a model probability score of 0.992.

possible_impact: Execution of attacker-controlled JavaScript in the victim browser.
Session theft, token theft, UI manipulation, or phishing-style redirection.

attack_preconditions: User-controlled data is rendered in browser output without proper escaping.
The application allows executable HTML or script-like payloads to reach the response.
mitigation: Apply strict output encoding for HTML, attributes, URLs, and JavaScript contexts.
Enable Content-Security-Policy (CSP) to reduce script execution risk.
Sanitize rich HTML input with a strict allow-list if HTML is required.

ai_sections.executive_summary: A high-severity Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payload classified as Script-tag XSS was detected in a POST request to /api/xai/report originating from IP address 127.0.0.1 using a WindowsPowerShell user agent. The payload <script>alert(1)</script> was identified with a model probability score of 0.992.
why_detected: The payload contains a explicit script tag construct paired with an alert call JavaScript function.
Pattern detection identified strong indicator script_tag along with weak indicators angle_brackets and alert_call.
Top TF-IDF feature tokens including ript>, ipt>, pt>, and cript contributed heavily to the model classification.
ai_sections.confidence_explanation: The model produced a confidence score of 0.992 for XSS (class index 2), which far exceeds the strong pattern threshold of 0.6. The final classification decision was resolved using the multi_allowed_choose_highest logic.

ai_sections.analyst_note: The request originated from a PowerShell client targeting /api/xai/report. While the payload represents a standard proof-of-concept alert attempt, actual exploitation is contingent upon whether the endpoint echoes or stores this input for presentation in a web browser context without sanitization.
